lesson: Every tool that declares required input refuses input that omits it, raising SCHEMA_MISMATCH while the plan is still compiling. This holds for write tools too, which means input is validated before the approval gate is ever reached: a malformed write is refused outright rather than turned into an approval request, so nobody is ever asked to approve a write that could not have run. It is the mirror of the gate sitting in front of a tool for well-formed input, and both are now proven rather than assumed.
